code_rule: PRC-SYSTEM-EQUIPMENT-###; plant and maintainable systems are parent assets; consumable internals belong in Parts & Inventory.

assets.name: Peace River Concrete Batch Plant
assets.notes: Overall plant registry. Reference is a control-screen process diagram, not a physical photograph of every component. The two cement silo icons require field mapping to the horizontal bulk store before creating further storage assets. Initial C3 criticality requires maintenance validation.

assets.name: Batching Control Operator Station
assets.notes: Photographed operator monitor and batching application. Screen identifies P1910, RUEL Concrete, Peace River. Controller, PLC and software version not verified.

assets.name: Horizontal Bulk Cement Storage Vessel
assets.notes: Identified by Adrian as the large cement storage pipa. Horizontal blue vessel with several discharge sections, fill couplings, valves, air lines and supports. Do not equate its sections to the two HMI silo icons without verification. Capacity, pressure rating and serial pending.

assets.name: Cement Transfer Blower 1
assets.notes: Identity and number supplied by Adrian. Photo 2: blower package with air intake/silencer, drive guard, hoses and connections. Drive specifications, manufacturer and serial pending; removable internals will be inventory parts, not duplicate assets.

assets.name: Cement Transfer Blower 2
assets.notes: Identity and number supplied by Adrian. Photo 3: blower package with air intake/silencer, drive guard, hoses and connections. Drive specifications, manufacturer and serial pending; removable internals will be inventory parts, not duplicate assets.

assets.name: Outdoor Hot Water Storage Tank
assets.notes: Vertical outdoor tank identified by Adrian. Visible lower connections and level scale. Capacity, construction and operating pressure not inferred from appearance.

assets.name: Aggregate Storage Heating Distribution
assets.notes: External header with individual isolation valves and flexible distribution branches beside aggregate storage. Heating medium, heat source, branch count and zone tags require verification; the image does not prove steam service.

assets.name: Water Heating System
assets.notes: Identified by Adrian as water heating. Skid includes cylindrical heater/burner assembly, blower/drive, control cabinet and piping. Fuel, model, capacity and pressure ratings pending.

assets.name: Water Heater Air Blower Package
assets.notes: Visible blue blower/silencer and motor assembly at rear of the heater skid. Shared skid photograph; exact air-service role and nameplate need verification.

assets.name: Water Heater Control Cabinet
assets.notes: White control cabinet visible on the left of the heater skid, with emergency stop, switches and instruments. Shared equipment photograph; electrical drawings and component tags pending.

assets.name: Indoor Batch Water Storage Tank
assets.notes: Internal vertical tank identified by Adrian as hot/cold water storage. Access ladder, level indication, upper piping and hose visible. Do not assign a capacity without a nameplate or dimensions.

assets.name: Indoor Water Transfer Pump Assembly
assets.notes: Pump/transfer assembly and green hoses visible at floor level beside the indoor tank. Equipment identity is visible; suction/discharge routing and duty need confirmation.

assets.name: Admixture Dosing Station Bank
assets.notes: Physical bank of graduated dosing vessels, valves, regulators/gauges, hoses and lower enclosures. Station product assignments below use HMI channel labels and require physical tag verification. The unused eighth HMI slot is not an installed asset.
